status: Twenty additional void helper CFGs reviewed under native return contracts; five width/truncation differences manually explained.
game_build: Unchanged C674 DLL/debug pair; no rebuild needed.

automatic_review.scope: Entry-reachable direct CFG correspondence under the listed exact-name/import/function-address identities. Ignore architectural no-ops and direct internal jump trampolines; preserve ordinary operations, registers, operand widths, prefixes and edge predicates, including paired inverse predicates. Shared/duplicated tails may correlate to the same instructions. This is structural evidence, not execution, callee/data-content equivalence, literal pointer-identity proof or a whole-game proof. Read-only C-string and declared DIALOG-token mappings compare complete contents through NUL, not storage identity, alias relationships or bytes beyond the terminator. Arbitrary PC/return-address inspection is outside this review. Calls are followed through normal returns only; exception/unwind/longjmp edges are not covered. Indirect jumps are refused. Unsupported operation, register, address and width differences remain unresolved. Raw scores and discovery differences are unchanged; current native/rebuilt ranges are pinned. Swapped global/stack-parameter equality loads may differ in EAX and non-ZF flags: both successors must overwrite/clobber EAX before any read and discard comparison flags before any use. Requires an ordinary disjoint C stack and global memory without concurrent mutation, MMIO, read-order-sensitive faults or asynchronous observation. Only named cross-CU cdecl calls are accepted as EAX/flag clobbers; unknown/inline register-argument calls remain unresolved. A single XOR EAX,EAX may move among an identical ordered sequence of 32-bit stack restores ending in a plain RET. No EAX reads/restores, flag consumers, memory writes, calls or conditional branches are accepted in those suffixes. Requires the ordinary C return ABI with EFLAGS unobserved after return and valid stack accesses; exceptions, asynchronous/intermediate state inspection and fault-order equivalence are outside this check. For functions with a current plain C void declaration and a named native C DWARF definition lacking any direct or inherited return type, equality scratch EAX may remain live only until an unprefixed operand-free RET. It still must not affect a memory address, store, argument, branch or any other instruction before return. Flags and ordinary operation/side-effect matching retain their existing checks. Return-register contents and EFLAGS are unobserved by the ordinary C void-return ABI; integer/pointer results and unknown declarations receive no relaxation. Optional pointer suffixes use structural symbolic expressions and equality decision trees, under native DWARF 32-bit pointer returns and matching current C char-pointer declarations. Only read-only MOV/extension/LEA/register AND/zero XOR/CMP/TEST, direct JE/JNE/internal JMP and ordinary stack restores/plain RET are supported. EAX, callee-saved registers and final ESP must agree on every modeled path. ECX, EDX and EFLAGS are caller-saved and unobserved after the ordinary C pointer return. Calls, stores, prefixes, cycles, other predicates/operations and state limits remain unresolved. Requires valid ordinary memory reads without concurrent mutation, volatile/MMIO effects, asynchronous intermediate observation or read/fault-order inspection; address/literal correspondences retain the assumptions above. No solver or sampled-input inference is used.

regression_checks.scope: Synthetic positive and negative regression checks for the void-return equality extension and inherited DWARF return declarations. Not gameplay tests.

manual_reviews.name: card_opalescence
manual_reviews.reason: Native OR EAX,dword [type+0x28] and rebuilt OR AL,byte [type+0x28] both feed OR 2 then MOV byte [type+0x28],AL. EAX is subsequently reloaded with affected_card before any helper call or other use of its high bits. The following reloads and call discard the differing OR flags.
manual_reviews.verdict: No source correction indicated by these reviewed difference sites.
manual_reviews.scope: Manual explanation of width/truncation sites, not an automated whole-function equivalence proof. Requires ordinary valid card records: wider native loads remain within the 72-byte record, with no volatile/MMIO effects, concurrent mutation, asynchronous high-register/flag observation or fault/read-width-sensitive behavior. Typed source fields remain unchanged.

manual_reviews.name: card_warden_of_the_wall
manual_reviews.reason: Native OR ECX,dword [type+0x28] and rebuilt OR CL,byte [type+0x28] both feed OR 2 and the same byte type-field store. ECX is then overwritten by the saved instance pointer before any use of the discarded high bits; the return/event tail has no consumer of the differing OR flags.

manual_reviews.name: card_rusted_relic
manual_reviews.reason: Native OR EDX,dword [type+0x28] and rebuilt OR DL,byte [type+0x28] differ only above bit 7. Both OR in TYPE_CREATURE, TEST EAX (overwriting the OR flags), and store the resulting DL to the type byte. The high EDX bits are not subsequently used; EDX is unobserved after the ordinary C return.

manual_reviews.name: turn_into_artifact
manual_reviews.reason: Native loads the existing type as a dword and rebuilt loads DL only, then ORs the type bits and TYPE_ARTIFACT into ECX and stores CL. High EDX/ECX bits never feed an address, condition or stored result. Subsequent helper calls use the same stack arguments; the differing high scratch bits and flags are not inputs under the identified ordinary cdecl calls.

manual_reviews.name: land_into_new_basic_land_type
manual_reviews.reason: The native dword OR of type fields feeds a byte store; rebuilt uses the corresponding byte OR. The later native dword toughness load feeds only a word store, while rebuilt loads that word directly. Intervening power uses CX and a word store on both sides. No high ECX bits enter another computation or return value; EFLAGS and ECX are unobserved at the ordinary C return. The remaining changed instruction is padding.

scope: Twenty previously unannotated full entry-reachable CFGs now correspond when a verified ordinary C void return makes residual EAX unobserved. Every one fails the same current checker with the void option disabled. Memory effects, predicates, calls and scratch uses before return retain the existing checks. Five additional width sites have explicitly scoped manual explanations. No score, game source, ABI declaration or candidate set is changed, and this is not whole-game or callee equivalence.
